description: This Java class 'PermissionRecorder' provides services to manage and record permissions related to Content entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for configuring permission checks, recording results, and generating HTML reports for permission validation.

classes.name: PermissionRecorder
classes.description: Main class providing permission recording and reporting functionalities for Content entities.

methods.name: getCheckMode
methods.description: Returns the current permission check mode.

methods.name: setCheckMode
methods.description: Sets the permission check mode.

methods.name: isOn
methods.description: Checks if the permission recorder is enabled.

methods.name: setOn
methods.description: Enables or disables the permission recorder.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Retrieves the user login information associated with the permission recorder.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Assigns user login information to the permission recorder.

methods.name: getEntityPermCheckResult
methods.description: Returns the result of the last entity permission check.

methods.name: setEntityPermCheckResult
methods.description: Sets the result of an entity permission check.

methods.name: getContentPurposeOperations
methods.description: Returns a clone of the array of content purpose operations.

methods.name: setContentPurposeOperations
methods.description: Sets the list of content purpose operations.

methods.name: getPrivilegeEnumId
methods.description: Retrieves the current privilege enumeration ID.

methods.name: setPrivilegeEnumId
methods.description: Sets the privilege enumeration ID.

methods.name: getStatusTargets
methods.description: Returns a clone of the status target array.

methods.name: setStatusTargets
methods.description: Sets the list of status targets.

methods.name: getTargetOperations
methods.description: Returns a clone of the target operations array.

methods.name: setTargetOperations
methods.description: Sets the list of target operations.

methods.name: setCurrentContentId
methods.description: Updates the current content ID and initializes related data structures if changed.

methods.name: getCurrentContentId
methods.description: Returns the current content ID.

methods.name: setRoles
methods.description: Assigns roles to the current content context.

methods.name: setPurposes
methods.description: Assigns purposes to the current content context.

methods.name: startMatchGroup
methods.description: Begins a permission match group with specified parameters.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records the result of a permission check for a specific operation, purpose, role, status, and privilege.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Generates an HTML report representing the permission check results.

methods.name: renderCurrentContentMapHtml
methods.description: Renders an HTML representation of a content map with permission check results.

methods.name: renderResultRowHtml
methods.description: Renders an HTML table row for individual permission check result.
